decision.summary: The copied durability court remains migration evidence only. The canonical Uniform Cell store has executable durability and ownership courts for revision history, WAL recovery, bounded read-only inspection, backup, atomic failure recovery, and exclusive database ownership.
accepted_canonical_behavior: current and historical Cell snapshots survive close and reopen
current-cell index recovery preserves the committed revision
read-only probes and bounded snapshots do not open or mutate an active owner
online backup preserves committed WAL history without overwriting an existing target
atomic commit failures recover either the exact old snapshot or complete new snapshot
a process owner excludes a concurrent writer and process death releases that ownership
rejected_or_not_promoted: runtime-copy database ownership or persistence implementation as a second canonical store
bulk copying runtime durability code into the canonical Cell authority
